#' 01_Data_Preparation.R
#' 
#' This script performs initial data cleaning for microbial metagenomics 
#' machine learning analysis. It covers the first phase of the lab practical:
#' Data Preparation.
#'
#' Steps:
#' 1. Cleaning Names and Columns
#' 2. Standardizing Feature Data Types
#' 3. Saving a prepared dataset for leakage-safe model training
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
otu_raw <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "otu_table.xls"),
                      sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

metadata <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "sample_data.xls"),
                       sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

colnames(metadata)[colnames(metadata) == "#SampleID"] <- "sample_id"
metadata$sample_id <- trimws(metadata$sample_id)

otu <- otu_raw %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("featureid") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

otu$sample_id <- rownames(otu)

dat <- dplyr::inner_join(metadata, otu, by = "sample_id")

# define outcome ONCE
dat$dx <- factor(dat$Disease.MESH.ID)
dat$dx <- factor(dat$dx, levels = c("D003093", "D006262"))

# remove leakage columns ONCE
dat <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_id, -Disease.MESH.ID, -Disease.name)

saveRDS(dat, file.path(results_dir, "prepared_data_final.rds"))

table(dat$dx)
```
